contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A highly worn copper-alloy Roman barbarous radiate of Tetricus I dating to the period AD 275-285 (Reece period 14). Based on a Spes Avgg or Spes Pvblica prototype of Tetricus I, RIC Vb Tetricus I 130-136. Obverse : crude radiate, bearded bust right. Legend: [__]. Reverse : Spes standing facing left. Legend : [SPES AVGG/SPES PVBBLICA]. Measurments - Weight: 0.52g, diameter: 10.12mm, thickness:…
